qualifications.statement: H40: Node-only store; a directory swap is detected after the fact, never prevented. Local single-user v1 only; re-review before any multi-user, shared-storage or cloud use, including MO-1309.
A6: a failed exclusive create of a staging file is a typed IO failure, never retried; two hypotheses (transient lock, delete-pending) remain unconfirmed. Re-reviewed with H40.
Tail truncation and rollback to an older valid prefix are not detectable without an external head anchor. Operators record each export and verify headDigest externally.
Purge removes record member names; a staging name left by an interrupted append may still hold the same bytes (to be characterized by 3C-E6).
After a purge the entry keeps recordDigest, member names, lengths and digests, and subjects; a digest can confirm a guess for small low-entropy content.
The tombstone authority reference is operator-chosen free text and is permanent.
An export taken before a tombstone keeps the bytes; there is no import and no recall.
verify does not re-run admission; an entry written by a party with filesystem access verifies if the chain and member digests are consistent.
The incremental SHA-256 (and the canonical module copy) is hand-written first-party code, verified by differential and example-vector tests and a recorded independent review.
Host latency under antivirus and indexers is heavy-tailed; recorded as an environment qualification, not a bound.
A 100,000-entry export takes about 16 minutes on the reference host; recorded as a MO-1309 performance follow-up, not a defect.
A4.4: POLICY_EVALUATION admission is inspection-only; READINESS_RESULT admission is not a MO-1307 verification.
Integrity only: no signatures, no authenticity, no encryption; access control is the operator filesystem responsibility (H07, H08).
Certification claims native Windows 11 x64 only (H45).
UNC, network, OneDrive and cloud-placeholder locations are observed, not claimed.
